data.name: Bahaaj
data.gender_notes: Bahaaj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-h-j', meaning 'to shine', 'to glow'. This name carries a sense of brilliance and radiance, evoking images of the light of God. The name Bahaaj carries the meaning “Glowing, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahaaj usually hope their child will grow to embody glowing, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine light that shines within us all.
data.etymology: Bahaaj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glowing, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahaaj total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
